name: Tome of Twilight
summary: The Twilight forces persist, and a clue points north of Sunnyglade. You are asked to find Nar'gurk and recover information from his stronghold.

sections.title: A Trail North
sections.body: The Twilight forces still come from somewhere unknown, so you are sent to Krol'dok Stronghold. A Twilight creature mentioned shadow magic and an ogre named Nar'gurk there. You are asked to kill him and recover any valuable information that may explain where the forces come from.

faq.answer: You are looking for Nar'gurk in Krol'dok Stronghold and any valuable information there.
Krol'dok Stronghold is north of Sunnyglade.

faq.q: Why am I looking for Nar'gurk?
faq.answer: A Twilight creature mentioned Nar'gurk and shadow magic while being asked where its former masters came from.
The information sought may help explain where the persistent Twilight forces are coming from.

attribution: In-game quest text: Tome of Twilight
